first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A low blue open-wheel single-seat race car with white wing surfaces and trim and exposed black tires; the rear-wing endplate bears a white number 6.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person in Vehicle A's cockpit wearing a light-and-black helmet with a dark horizontal visor, with most of the body occluded by the vehicle body.

entities.name: gray asphalt racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface on which Vehicle A is traveling, with a white line or blue-and-white segmented curb along parts of the far boundary.

entities.name: grass shoulder
entities.identification: A continuous green grassy area outside the racetrack, with blurry variations between lighter and darker tones.

entities.name: white guardrail
entities.identification: A long guardrail behind the grass shoulder, composed of multiple parallel light-colored horizontal rails.

entities.name: blue-and-white segmented curb
entities.identification: A narrow strip extending along the far edge of the racetrack and composed of alternating blue and white segments.

entities.name: green paved runoff area
entities.identification: A broad, light-green paved strip behind Vehicle A, with relatively uniform coloration.

entities.name: mesh fence above the white guardrail
entities.identification: A fence above the white guardrail, composed of thin gray lines and vertical posts.

entities.name: gray paved strip outside the racetrack
entities.identification: A horizontal gray paved strip located between the green paved runoff area and the grass above it, separate from the racetrack beneath Vehicle A.
